note: The Solomon Islands: every visitor applies before travelling through the Immigration Division's e-visa portal and shows the grant letter on arrival. Free of a visa fee by mutual agreement (the online lodgement fee aside): the EU's members, the United Arab Emirates, China (from 27 January 2025), Hong Kong (from 26 August 2026), Japan, India and Indonesia for up to 90 days, single entry; Fiji, Papua New Guinea and Vanuatu the Melanesian Spearhead Group visa (3 months, multiple entries); and the nationals of the countries listed the free 30-day tourist permit. Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, Switzerland and Israel enter without a visa for 90 days in 180 by Wikipedia's copy. Everyone else applies for a tourist visa (USD 50 and the USD 50 lodgement fee, up to 3 months). Taiwan's permit on arrival was cancelled in April 2025. Read on 2026-11-03 from the Division's own pages, which corrected Wikipedia's copy, read before: the free entries are applied for online (held as e-Visas, not as entry without one), China's and Hong Kong's are 90 days, not 30, India's and Indonesia's 90-day exemptions were missing, and the tourist visa is 3 months. The Division doesn't name the free 30-day permit's nationalities, which stand on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Division, 30 days - Tourist permit
sources.said: You are required to apply well in advance from abroad through the e-visa portal before enter Solomon Islands. A grant letter will be issued when your application is approved. You must present your visa grant letter to Immigration officers at the port of entry. Visa validity 30 days (single entry only) from the date of arrival into Solomon Islands ... This tourist permit is free. However, an online lodgement fee of $50 USD will be charged.
